content: The study compares the use of steroids versus standard of care (SOC) or placebo in the treatment of COVID-19. 1. All-cause mortality (overall): A total of 13 studies involving 8,535 participants were analyzed. For patients with moderate illness, the risk ratio (RR) was 0.89 [95% CI: 0.80, 1.00]. For patients with severe or critical illness, the RR was 0.33 [95% CI: 0.01, 7.96]. For patients with moderate to severe illness, the RR was 0.88 [95% CI: 0.77, 1.01]. For patients with mild to moderate illness, the RR was 0.63 [95% CI: 0.18, 2.18]. 2. All-cause mortality (severe vs. non-severe cases): Among 13 studies with 8,535 participants, the subgroup analysis included 10 studies with 8,328 severe or critical cases and 3 studies with 207 mild or moderate cases. For severe or critical cases, the RR was 0.89 [95% CI: 0.80, 1.00]. For mild or moderate cases, the RR was 1.04 [95% CI: 0.68, 1.61]. 3. All-cause mortality by steroid type: Dexamethasone: RR was 0.89 [95% CI: 0.80, 1.00]. Hydrocortisone: RR was 0.90 [95% CI: 0.83, 0.98]. Methylprednisolone: RR was 0.84 [95% CI: 0.47, 1.49]. Prednisolone: RR was 0.75 [95% CI: 0.44, 1.28]. 4. Time to invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV): The mean difference was 5.00 days [95% CI: 2.45, 7.55]. 5. Clinical recovery: The RR for clinical recovery was 1.12 [95% CI: 0.80, 1.57]. 6. Serious adverse events: The RR for serious adverse events was 0.66 [95% CI: 0.34, 1.27]. 7. ICU admission: The RR for ICU admission was 1.01 [95% CI: 0.68, 1.50]. 8. Time to clinical improvement: The mean difference was -1.26 days [95% CI: -7.72, 5.21]. 9. Length of hospital stay: The mean difference was 0.16 days [95% CI: -1.23, 1.55]. 10. Ventilator-free days: The mean difference was 2.44 days [95% CI: 0.44, 4.44]. 11. Number of discharged patients: The RR for the number of discharged patients was 1.04 [95% CI: 0.97, 1.11]. 12. Need for invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) or extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO): The RR was 0.83 [95% CI: 0.69, 1.00]. These findings provide a detailed comparison of the effects of steroids versus SOC or placebo in various clinical outcomes related to COVID-19.
